{{Quote|All right, this is a ''Code Aurek'' alert. I want each of you to search every nook, every cranny, for a place this Rodent could be hiding.|Rex, to the rookie clone troopers stationed on Pastil|<ref name="MH" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''skirmish''' took place inside a [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]] on [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]].

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|What do you think, Stripe? They do this at every inspection?''"<br />"''Don't ask stupid questions, Bouncer.|[[Bouncer (clone trooper)|Bouncer]] and [[Stripe]]|<ref name="MH" />}}
[[File:Skirmish_on_Pastil.jpg|thumb|left|215px|Rex, Stripe and another clone trooper hunting down the [[wheel]]s of Rodent]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]] was the location of a [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and operated by [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="MH" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Rookies" /><ref name="Rookies Date" /> [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] inspected the [[Listening post/Legends|tracking station]] on Pastil.<ref name="MH" />

During their inspection, they uncovered a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]],<ref name="TOSVC32">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 32|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 32]]</ref> a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] that was nicknamed "[[Rodent (droid)|Rodent]]" by the rookie clone troopers stationed on Pastil.<ref name="MH" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The tracking station at Pastil is fully operational. Captain Rex and I are proceeding to the outpost in the Rishi system.|Cody, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="GA">''[[The Clone Wars: Grievous Attacks!]]''</ref>}}
Following their inspection, Marshal Commander Cody and Captain Rex reported to [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that the tracking station was fully operational, and proceeded to the [[Rishi Station/Legends|outpost]] in the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]], where they [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|prevented]] a major [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] incursion.<ref name="Rookies" />
